author: Mark Atwood
text: Related workspace-API findings extending the same default-impl-silent-spec-violation pattern across the workspace: bd:JMAP-ops7.23 (tasks-server update_task_per_user §4.5.1) and bd:JMAP-ops7.24 (metadata-server get_metadata_changes §3.3). When the canonical resolution for this bead lands, the propagation must include those two sibling cases. ops7.23 is parallel-correctness-violation (drop default like calendars); ops7.24 has a partial-compliance handler post-filter that adds a third pattern variant to the workspace and needs an explicit choose-one decision.
